name: Sites
description: UK commercial properties managed through the SafeFlow FM platform. Each site represents a building or property complex with its own WhatsApp number for tenant communications.
record_count_estimate: Low volume - typically tens to low hundreds of site records

fields.name: site_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each site

fields.name: site_name
fields.description: Display name for the property or building

fields.name: address_line_1
fields.description: Primary address line (street number and name)

fields.name: address_line_2
fields.description: Secondary address line (building name, suite, etc.)

fields.name: city
fields.description: City or town

fields.name: county
fields.description: County or administrative region

fields.name: postcode
fields.description: UK postcode format (e.g. SW1A 1AA, EC2R 8AH)

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country, defaults to United Kingdom

fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.description: WhatsApp Business number for this site in +44 format (e.g. +44 20 7946 0958)

fields.name: site_type
fields.description: Category of commercial property

fields.name: subscription_tier
fields.description: Service level subscription tier determining SLA thresholds and feature access

fields.name: primary_contact
fields.description: Main point of contact for this site

fields.name: property_manager
fields.description: Property manager responsible for this site

fields.name: work_items
fields.description: All work items associated with this site

fields.name: operating_hours
fields.description: Standard operating hours for the site (e.g. Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00)

fields.name: emergency_contact_number
fields.description: Emergency out-of-hours contact number in +44 format

fields.name: access_instructions
fields.description: Instructions for accessing the site, including key codes, security procedures, and parking information

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether the site is currently active and accepting work items

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the site record was created

fields.name: total_open_items
fields.description: Count of all linked work items that are not in CLOSED or CANCELLED state

views.name: Active Sites
views.description: Only sites currently accepting work items

views.name: By Subscription Tier
views.description: Sites grouped by their subscription tier

views.name: By Property Manager
views.description: Sites grouped by assigned property manager
